units: Gen. R. s. 21, end מי מציל … מאש לוֹהֶטֶת זו what will save my children from this glowing fire (hell)?; a. e.—Part. pass. לָהוּט, f. לְהוּטָה; pl. לְהוּטִים, לְהוּטִין; לְהוּטוֹת glowing; (with אחר) passionately following, anxious for.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>ל׳ אחר גרונו</he>, v. <cite ref="C01302"><he>גָּרוֹן</he></cite>. Y. Taan. VI, 69ᵇ; Pesik. Dibré, p. 114ᵃ <he>שהיו ישראל ל׳ אחר וכ׳</he> (not <he>שיהו</he>) the Israelites were greedy for sweet things.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:5">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>היו ל׳ אחר האדמה</he> had a passion for agriculture.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:7">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>ל׳ … אחרי שכינה</he> the Israelites were anxious for the Divine Presence; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 4 (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 57:5">Ps. LVII, 5</cite>) <he>שהיו לוֹהֲטִים אחר לה״ר</he> (= <cite ref="L00052"><he>לְהוּטִים</he></cite>) they had a passion for denunciation; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII; Yalk. ib. 637</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 213:1">Yalk. Kings 213</cite> <he>להוטים</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:42">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>האש מְלַהֶטֶת סביבותיו</he> the fire was shining around him.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:9">Gen. R. s. 21</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:24">Gen. III, 24</cite>) <he>שהיא מתהפכת … ומְלַהַטְתּוֹ וכ׳</he> it (the fire of hell) turns around man and heats him through from top to bottom &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>לִיהֲטוֹ האש</he> the fire seized him; a. e.
